preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input text.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() if (lines := stdin.splitlines()) else False
preconditions.description: The first line of input contains a single integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(n_line) <= 500000 and len(s_line) == int(n_line) and all(c in 'VK?' for c in s_line) for case in cases for n_line, s_line in case)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 500,000, the string has length n, and consists only of 'V', 'K', and '?'. The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two lines for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[2*i]) == len(valid_periods[i]) for i in range(num_test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the first output line is the count of valid periods.

postconditions.expression: all(' '.join(map(str, sorted(valid_periods[i]))) == stdout_lines[2*i + 1] for i in range(num_test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the second output line lists the valid periods in increasing order, separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(d in valid_periods[i] == (1 <= d <= n_i and any(all((s[j] == '?' or s[j] == s[j+d]) and (s[j+d] == '?' or s[j] == s[j+d]) for j in range(n_i - d)) for s in replacements(s_i)) for i, n_i, s_i in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: A value d is a valid period for a test case if and only if there exists at least one replacement of '?' with 'V' or 'K' such that the resulting string has period d, where period d means s[j] == s[j+d] for all valid j.
